articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Optimization and Voltage Control of Power Grid based on Gravity Energy Storage Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to solve the voltage problem of power grid after a high proportion of renewable energy is connected in the new type power system, a reactive power optimization and voltage control method considering gravity energy storage is proposed. This paper analyzes the power model and the reactive power compensation principle of gravity energy storage theoretically, establishes the mathematical models of reactive power optimization and voltage control with the minimum total deviation of node voltage as the objective function. Taking power flow, system operation conditions and energy storage power as constraints, the particle swarm optimization algorithm based on competition theory is used to solve the equation, and the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method are verified by simulation examples.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Temperature Monitoring System Using ZigBee Network and TMP102 Sensor Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of mechanized coal mining technology, the types and quantity of explosion-proof combination switches in coal mines are increasing. Based on the analysis of temperature wax Discoloration method, optical fiber technology temperature measurement method, infrared handheld device temperature measurement method and ZigBee network wireless temperature measurement method, this paper puts forward the design scheme of coal mine explosion-proof combined switch temperature on-line monitoring system, and designs the communication circuit between ZigBee network and temperature sensor in detail to realize the on-line monitoring of coal mine explosion-proof combined switch temperature.

articleTitle: Sharing platform of digital specimen of wood canker based on WebGIS in Xinjiang province: architecture, design and implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The collection, integration, analysis and sharing of digital specimens of wood canker is an important basic work for conducting relevant scientific research, education and teaching. In this study, for all kinds of users, such as scientific research, education, experts and the public, the architecture of Sharing platform of digital specimen of wood canker in Xinjiang province was designed by microservice architecture, the microservice function tree was constructed by domain-driven design method, the microservice cluster was built by using Spring Cloud technology components, and 8 kinds of microservices were developed based on WebGIS technology. The application results show that the platform is easy to use, provides data sharing and services through visualization and interactivity, and can provide decision-making data resources support for scientific research, education, monitoring, quarantine and prevention of wood canker.

articleTitle: Short-term oil price prediction based on CEEMD decomposition noise reduction and ARMIA-SSA-BP combination model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Oil as the ‘ blood of industry’ its price volatility has a huge political and economic impact on the world, so how to predict crude oil price more accurately has always been an important issue of concern. This paper proposes a combination model based on CEEMD decomposition noise reduction and ARMIA-SSA-BP. The daily crude oil futures prices of 9735 trading days from April 6, 1983, to March 15, 2007, were studied. The CEEMD method is used to decompose it into four components, ARIMA, BP and SSA - BP are used to forecast. Through the comparison of prediction accuracy, the optimal results are obtained and added, thus combining multiple prediction models and improving the prediction accuracy. The combination model has higher prediction accuracy than the original model.

articleTitle: NSCT-DWT-SVD Composite Digital Watermarking Algorithm based on QR Code
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to enhance the security of the watermark and to ensure the stability of the algorithm against attacks and the concealment of the watermark, a NSCT-DWT-SVD composite digital watermarking algorithm based on QR code is proposed. First, QR code encoding is conducted on the original watermark image to generate a QR code watermark image. In order to ensure the security of the watermark information, Arnold scrambling and encryption is performed on the QR code watermark information. Second, the original Lena image is carried out NSCT transform. The low frequency part that stores more information are selected for DWT. Then the low-frequency images with strong image resistance are performed SVD. The encrypted watermark information are embedded into the decomposed singular values. Through the experimental verification of the algorithm, the algorithm has strong concealment and strong resistance to conventional attacks on the basis of ensuring the security of watermarking. Especially for the rotation attack and JPEG compression attack, the NC values are above 0.92 and 1, respectively.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Neural Network in Teaching Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Nowadays, Teaching quality evaluation are facing challenges. Artificial Neural Network is conductive to developing a new system of evaluation. Facial recognition helps to record attendance in class; emotion analysis and behavior analysis contribute to get real-time feedback of students' emotion, engagement and activity in class.

articleTitle: Analysis on Life Cycle Cost Effectiveness Mathematical Evaluation Model of Pumped Storage Generating Set
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Under the requirement of fine and systematic equipment management of new power system, the highly asset-intensive equipment such as generator unit of pumped storage power plant is confronted with development problems such as extensive management and ambiguous operation and maintenance benefits. With the continuous increase of equipment asset value and the transformation of equipment management mode in power grid, equipment such as pumped storage generator unit urgently needs systematic scientific method to comprehensively evaluate the economy and reliability of equipment operation. Based on the full life cycle cost theory, this paper models and analyses the management cost input and equipment operation efficiency output of the pumped storage generator unit, which is a key equipment for peak regulation and frequency regulation, during all stages of the full life cycle, carries out equipment life cycle cost aggregation, estimation and equipment operation efficiency calculation based on ADC model, and evaluates and analyses the coupling result of cost efficiency by using Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA). Solve the results of life cycle cost efficiency evaluation, provide feasible methods to solve the difficult problems such as cost-efficiency modeling and parameter model of pumped storage unit, and provide guidance for management business such as overall purchasing decision and operation and maintenance benefit evaluation of pumped storage unit.

articleTitle: Optimal Layout of Charging Stations based on Intelligent Traffic Flow Research and Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the charging pile planning problem under the actual background. Taking the Chaoyang District of Beijing as the research object. The topography of Beijing is regular and can be divided into different traffic districts by grid method. We transform the demand for charging piles under the scale of electric vehicles into allocating various numbers of charging piles to different traffic analysis zones. Utilizing the gravity model to further simplify the problem, establish the optimal model of the site layout and combine the knowledge of queuing theory. And finally search for the optimal layout of the site in the city with the genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: Prediction model of automobile wind drag coefficient based on moth optimization algorithm and ELM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The prediction model of automotive aerodynamic drag coefficient can make a quick decision on the influence of characteristic parameters on aerodynamic drag coefficient and reduce the calculation times in automotive aerodynamic development. In order to establish a high-precision prediction model to meet the requirements of automobile aerodynamics design, Hammersley sampling is used to select sample points, and the prediction model of wind drag coefficient based on extreme learning machine (ELM) is established. Then, the moth flame algorithm (MFO) is used to optimize the model to improve its generalization ability. Finally, the prediction model is applied to aerodynamics design of a passenger car. The results show that the optimized prediction model is lower than the original prediction model of extreme learning machine, and the root mean square error is only 0.593%, which is 43.57% less than the original prediction error. In the aerodynamic design of a passenger car, the resistance value obtained by using MFO-ELM model is lower than that obtained by conventional optimization, and the drag reduction rate is 7.04<sup>%</sup>, and the number of simulation calculation is reduced by 20.8%, which meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Application of Data Acquisition System of AD9220 based on FPGA in Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: A high-speed data acquisition system is designed, which is based on FPGA and high-speed A/D conversion chip AD9220, to replace the original analog data acquisition system of shaker table power amplifier. The sequence of AD9220 is given, and the timing conversion relationship of AD is controlled by Quartus, which is program development software of Altera Company. Finally, the simulation of the working sequence of AD is realized by Signaltap, and the reduction of the analog signal waveform is achieved by the signal generator. The simulation results prove the correctness of the working sequence and the reliability of the hardware system, which can meet the requirements of high-speed data acquisition. Finally, this result is confirmed in the actual shaker table power amplifier.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Breast Cancer Gene Regulation Network based on Boolean Network Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Boolean network technology was used to construct and analyze breast cancer gene regulation network. Methods: Collect known breast cancer related genes and their regulatory relationships and visualize them, decompose the network through topological structure analysis, and make Boolean rules according to the regulatory relationships between genes. On the basis of previous studies, the paper uses mathematical analysis method to establish a Boolean control network model. The initial state of the network evolves with the method of Boolean rules, and the main attractors obtained correspond to the health state. Introducing the mathematical tool of semi tensor product of matrix, we analyze the attractor control of Boolean gene control network, knock out the key genes which have great influence on the output of the network, simulate gene mutation, and analyze the attractor change of the new network. Results: After the key gene has been knocked out, the attractor of the network has different degrees of development to the direction of canceration. Boolean network model can effectively simulate the dynamic gene regulation process of breast cancer and provide a reference optimal control gene node for the treatment of breast cancer.

articleTitle: Research on Improved ICP Geomagnetic Matching Simulation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Geomagnetic assisted matching navigation is a new research direction in the field of integrated navigation technology, which provides a new means for passive positioning of underwater vehicles. In view of the traditional ICP algorithm as important matching navigation algorithm, there are high requirements for initial point position, real time capability is not strong, slow search speed and so on, in this paper, the algorithm was improved, improved in combination with K - nearest neighbor search and normal vector estimation, the rotation matrix are deduced with the method of forming the same Angle as the invariant features and translation vector to realize the early registration, ICP algorithm based on octree was used for accurate registration. Based on the MATLAB environment, the simulation experiment of the improved ICP algorithm for geomagnetic matching is implemented. The research shows that the improved algorithm can improve the registration accuracy and shorten the registration time, and has obvious advantages.

articleTitle: Application of hyperspectral imaging technology in quality inspection of agricultural products
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the improvement of China's economic level, society and residents attach great importance to the quality and safety of agricultural products in daily life. Hyperspectral analyzer integrates image and spectral technology to obtain spatial and spectral information of the research object. It has the characteristics of non-damage, precision and fast, and has become one of the main technical means in the quality detection of agricultural products. According to the latest research results at home and abroad, this paper introduces the principle and system of hyperspectral imaging technology, classifies and summarizes the application of hyperspectral imaging technology in agricultural product quality detection, points out its advantages and disadvantages, and analyzes the development direction of hyperspectral imaging technology in agricultural product detection in the future.

articleTitle: Time series probabilistic power flow calculation of distribution network based on nonparametric kernel density estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the continuous development and progress of power system and the grid connected operation of high-capacity photovoltaic, wind power and other new energy power generation, the grid structure of modern power system is becoming more and more complex. The input and removal of wind power and photovoltaic power generation system make the uncertain factors of power system operation increasing. The traditional deterministic power flow calculation method can not accurately reflect the actual operation state of the current power grid with high proportion of renewable energy. In order to deal with the randomness brought by high permeability new energy access to distribution network, this paper proposes a time-series probability power flow calculation method of distribution network based on nonparametric kernel density estimation. This method can greatly improve the accuracy of power flow calculation and reflect the operation state of power grid under high permeability new energy access in real time. In this paper, a year can be divided into 12 typical time series. Under each time series, the nonparametric kernel density estimation method is used to establish the probability density model for the output of new energy such as wind power and photovoltaic, and then the semi-invariant mathematical analysis method and Gram-Charlie series expansion are used to solve the time series probability power flow under the corresponding time series. Finally, an 8-node example is used to verify the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Research on the Digital Protection Technology of Intangible Cultural Heritage Information under Computer Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The protection of intangible cultural heritage has a single form and poor interaction. In response to this problem, this paper proposes designing and implementing a digital online display system for intangible cultural heritage based on mobile augmented reality technology. The digital protection of intangible cultural heritage cultural information designed in this paper applies the main functional modules of the cloud and mobile terminals. The system uses a rapid modeling method based on 3D scanning and meshes iterative simplification. In order to introduce this method in detail, this paper discusses the functions and paths of intangible cultural heritage information protection from the aspects of function distribution, data structure, module construction, technical support, and implementation subjects. This paper finds that the knowledge modeling of intangible cultural heritage resources based on computer artificial intelligence technology eases the designer's knowledge reasoning process, and this information digital protection system improves the accuracy of product cultural connotation expression.

articleTitle: Applications of Deep Learning in Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Computer vision includes many branches, among which image classification, object detection, image segmentation, and object tracking are the most important research topics in the field of computer vision. Object detection is the foundation for tackling more difficult and higher-level visual tasks, including segmentation, scene understanding, object tracking, image description, event detection, and activity recognition, since it is the baseline of image understanding and computer vision. In the past decade, deep learning object detection algorithms based on CNN have developed rapidly, and many detection algorithms have emerged with better performance than traditional or earlier algorithms. This paper summarizes the representative object detection algorithms proposed in recent years and introduces them in two parts: region proposal-based methods and regression/classification-based methods. By introducing the idea in detail and the main features of each algorithm and the network structure, it helps one understand the two methods and their representative algorithms and the existing problems in the object detection field.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Detection System of Computer Digital Security Protection Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The network intrusion detection system is widely used in the construction of network security; it can effectively identify potential behaviors that endanger network security. Based on the analysis of the flaws of firewalls and intrusion detection systems in network security protection, this paper proposes a new and improved network security protection method. This paper uses advanced technologies such as firewall and intrusion detection, anti-virus, identity authentication, and network vulnerability assessment in network security protection, and a set of safe and effective network security defense systems are established on TDCS.

articleTitle: Design of Web Application Firewall System through Convolutional Neural Network and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Attacks against web applications emerge in endlessly, and protecting the security of web applications is an important part of the current cyberspace security. This paper constructs one cloud web application firewall system based on deep learning. The system architecture adopts a multi-server distributed architecture. Taking into account the real-time nature of web requests and the user's sense of user experience, through the use of a high-performance server framework Openers and high-efficiency volumes. The convolutional neural network improves the operating efficiency of the system while ensuring the recognition rate. At the same time, the system implemented in this paper also saves server request information in the database to further provide targeted data sets for artificial intelligence training.

articleTitle: AGV path scheduling optimization model of transport robot based on ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rise of today's e-commerce industry, the requirements for logistics and storage are getting higher and higher, ordinary manual storage system can not meet the demand, unmanned warehouse management system is introduced, unmanned warehouse management, the most important is intelligent equipment, that is, AGV intelligent car. Current research on AGV at home and abroad is mainly based on two aspects, one is the working model of AGV, the other is related hardware configuration. In this paper, the work model of AGV is proposed to improve the work efficiency of AGV and save resources, in order to provide a contribution to the follow up research of AGV.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization in Geomagnetic Matching Navigation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to increase the localization accuracy of traditional geomagnetic matching algorithms, this paper propose a new geomagnetic matching algorithm based on improved Particle swarm optimization. Traditional PSO algorithm has premature convergence of particles, which not only destroys the diversity of particles, but also leads to mismatches. In this paper, the modified Metropolis criterion is applied to particle swarm optimization (PSO), and the campaign idea is introduced into the campaign algorithm, so as to obtain an improved particle swarm optimization geomagnetic matching algorithm. Finally, through simulation analysis, the matching accuracy and matching time based on improved PSO and traditional PSO matching algorithm are compared. The simulation results show that the improved PSO algorithm outperforms the traditional PSO algorithm, and the matching time is slightly longer than that of PSO algorithm, but meets the real-time requirement.

articleTitle: Research on hole feature matching based on image restoration
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that stains and strong light reduce the accuracy of light hole and threaded hole matching in the process of traditional template matching, a template matching method for body in white hole feature based on image restoration is proposed. Firstly, the patch match repair method is used to repair the image of stains and strong light, so as to eliminate the interference of the two to the matching. Then the light hole and thread are matched by combining the gray matching method of improved search strategy and the edge feature matching method respectively. Finally, the sub-pixel coordinate fitting is performed on the matching results. Experimental results show that the accuracy of matching smooth holes and threaded holes can reach 100<sup>%</sup> and 98%, and the difference between matching accuracy and commercial software matching accuracy is less than 0.3.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Online Video Tutoring Technology in University Practical Course Education
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Nowadays, various types of educational websites, online schools, and online education colleges are booming, and online teaching has become a useful supplement to traditional teaching. It not only effectively improves the allocation of teaching resources, but also solves the problem that traditional teaching is limited by time and space. This paper puts forward the design idea of using J2EE technology system as the structural framework to develop network courses, and describes the process of system development using J2EE technology system in detail. This system is a network application software developed by JSPServlet, bean, JDBC and other related Java technologies according to the J2EE standard. The development of the system is based on the multi-layer architecture of Web server, application server and database server. This multi-layer structure can separate the business logic, user interface, content display and other parts of data processing, so that the business logic of the system is concentrated in the Application level. Using the reusability and cross-platform nature of JavaBean components, complex and large-scale platform applications can be rapidly developed and re-developed.

articleTitle: Transmission Efficiency Analysis and Data Calculation of vue.js Component in Front and Back Interaction Process
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to explore the stability and efficiency of the four commonly used value-transfer components of the Vue.JS framework under the application layer of the Internet of Things (IOT) agricultural greenhouses, we achieved component development by combing the front end and implemented a business model with the Vue.JS framework on the backend in this paper. In addition, aiming at the problem of the efficiency of signal transfer between page components, we applied the MongoDB database system to explore and research transmission efficiency of four value transfer methods, such as value-transfer by routers with diameters, value-transfer by setting Session Storage cache, value-transfer from parent components to child components, and value-transfer by emit events' child components, and obtained response data through a simulation test, thus proving that the value-transfer method is more efficient in this environment. The paper provides an important solution for the key problems of similar environment platforms in the future.

articleTitle: Computer Technology and Artificial Intelligence Applied in Smart English Audiovisual Course System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This article guides the construction of English audio-visual course system from the theory of language information system in neurocognitive linguistics. Neurocognitive linguistics believes that English audio-visual courses should give full play to the characteristics of multimedia, provide students with diversified input corpus as much as possible, and design supporting teaching activities. Teaching methods can be diversified, such as movies, TV shows, TV shows, and music TV, supplemented by other teaching materials. We establish the association between computer technology learning behavior and the brain, and deepen our understanding of the cognitive neural mechanism of computer technology platforms. On the basis of the interaction between the computer technology platform and the language, the computer technology platform intervention method that promotes language learning is cut from the English audio-visual course learning. Studies have shown that the English audio-visual course system can be well integrated with the abstract information process in neurocognitive linguistics. At the same time, the English audiovisual course system can also play a role in promoting the improvement of neurocognitive linguistics.

articleTitle: Knowledge graph construction of multi-source heterogeneous academic resources based on big data technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the big data environment, academic communication resources suffer from multi-source heterogeneity and information overload, which makes it more difficult to integrate, manage, and share. Therefore, a knowledge graph architecture is proposed for academic communication resources based on the hierarchy of “Ontology-Resource-Description-Intelligence”. The key technologies for knowledge graph construction, including academic communication resources acquisition, knowledge fusion, and knowledge storage, are designed and implemented, in which it has more than 80,000 entities and 120,000 relationships. And on this basis, its future application and development are analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Student Information Management System based on Web
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, China's higher education has ushered in a new situation of vigorous development. The enrollment scale of colleges and universities has been expanding, and the teaching management burden of colleges and universities has become heavier and heavier. Adopting traditional student information management mode, such as direct manual management or management system with low openness, will inevitably waste a lot of human, material and financial resources. How to improve the level of student information management and establish a student information management system suitable for their own colleges has become an important problem that needs to be solved urgently in the process of school information construction. Considering the practicality and economy, building a network management platform based on Web technology is an important task and development direction of teaching management in most colleges and universities. Using web technology to build a school student information management platform aims to explore an Internet-based teaching management model. Through this new management mode, we will create a new teaching management environment for the college, make the management break through the time and space constraints, improve the work efficiency and management level, and enable school administrators, teachers and students to learn and communicate through the network at any time and anywhere. This paper mainly discusses the implementation scheme of designing and developing student information management system based on Web architecture and ASP technology. The development of this system has certain promotion and practical value for the development and design of similar systems.

articleTitle: A Study on the Construction of Traditional Chinese Medicine Multimodal Corpus under the View of Self-media
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: From the perspective of corpus construction, this paper discusses the collection and annotation methods of traditional Chinese medicine multimodal language materials on the self-media and the building technical software-ELAN. This research establishes a multimodal corpus of traditional Chinese medicine by collecting videos related to traditional Chinese medicine in a representative self-media and using Elan for transcription and multi-level annotation. Based on the significant advantages of the multimodal corpus, it aims to reflect the image of traditional Chinese medicine on the self-media platform, and provide some empirical support for the development of traditional Chinese medicine.

articleTitle: Research on computer network information security management and protection strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of network information technology, we have entered the era of big data. Under this background, computer network information security has also become a major hidden danger. It is extremely important to strengthen the security maintenance of computer network. Therefore, the problem of network information security needs to be solved urgently. This paper presents a computer network information security management method based on big data. Deploy the network probe on the PC server to obtain the network traffic information; Principal component analysis and tabu search algorithm will be used to select the characteristic index of network traffic information; Based on BP neural network classification and identification of abnormal behavior, in order to prevent illegal attacks in time and ensure the security of network information. The experimental results show that the detection rate of the four attack modes using the design method is more than 95%, and the false positive rate is less than 1.5%, which proves that the security management effect of this method is good.

articleTitle: Experimental research on the colour interpolation algorithm of the full colour image
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of multimedia technology, images have become the main data form of people's daily communication and information expression. In order to ensure fast data transmission, much effort has been made to compress the three-channel color image into the 2D matrix and then recover the image from the 2D matrix through interpolation algorithms. However, there usually exists different degrees of edge blurring or noise generation when reconstructing images, which significantly affects the accuracy of reconstruction. More importantly, we find that different interpolation algorithms may have drastic performance differences when dealing with different scene images. All of these aspects inspire us to explore the application boundary of interpolation algorithms. In this paper, we compare the representative bilinear interpolation, cok interpolation and Hibbard interpolation from the degree of edge blurring, the amount of noise generated and the processing speed. With extensive experiments, both visual and quantitative analysis shows an interesting but meaningful result. Three algorithms obtain a similar accuracy for the image with a single color or simple lines, while the Hibbard algorithm could restore the most realistic image when the image structure is complex.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Classroom Construction in the Information Age under Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The data storage consists of three parts: SARM storage, CD-ROM and hard disk. The OLAP server is arranged, and the switch is used to realize the functional integration of front-end tools and applications. Through the personalized data analysis model, the data mining parallelization technology is adopted, the data clustering center is updated through the K-means clustering algorithm and the MapReduce parallel computing framework, the clustering performance index is minimized, and the data in the personalized data source is effectively mined. Analysis, the conclusions after analysis are regularized to generate teaching rules, which are presented to students through human-computer interaction to improve the intelligence and personalization of the teaching system.

articleTitle: Short-term traffic flow prediction based on the combined model of SSA-VMD decomposition and IPSO-LSTM-ATTENTION
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Short-term traffic flow prediction is of great significance to the construction of an urban intelligent transportation system. In order to solve the problem of complexity and timing of traffic flow data, this paper proposes a method for traffic flow prediction based on a combination model of SSA-VMD decomposition model and IPSO-LSTM-ATTENTION prediction model. In this paper, the sparrow search algorithm and the variational modal decomposition (VMD) method are combined to decompose the traffic flow data, so that the decomposition results are more rapid and accurate. Secondly, based on the TTENTION mechanism, the time series characteristics of traffic flow data are extracted by using long-short-term memory (LSTM) networks, which makes the prediction model more effective in processing long-term sequence inputs. Moreover, an improved particle swarm algorithm (IPSO) is used to make LSTM networks more accurate and timely. In order to verify the validity of the model, this paper uses the data from the UK Highway Dataset for simulation analysis, and the experimental results show that: The prediction accuracy of the SSA-VMD-IPSO-LSTM-ATTENTION model is better than that of the single model. The results show that the model has better timeliness and higher accuracy.

Author Keywords: Improved Particle Pwarm Optimization-Long Short-Term Memory Network

articleTitle: Deep Neural Networks for Stock Market Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Stock market is an important product of human economic activity and plays an important role in people's daily life. Every day, a large amount of trading data is generated, and this massive amount of data has led some researchers to try to predict stock prices. In recent years, with the rapid development of artificial intelligence in several fields, some researchers have used deep learning methods to predict stock prices. Researchers have proposed a large number of methods to try to improve the prediction results. However, these methods have not been well summarized by researchers.

articleTitle: Trading Strategies Model based on Neural Network and Multi-objective Planning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To help investors make an optimal daily trading plan, this paper uses machine learning to predict returns and solve the portfolio model after processing the given data. Firstly, this paper establishes an asset portfolio model based on neural networks and multi-objective planning, combining the two methods with different principles for asset portfolio prediction. Combining Markowitz's mean-variance model based on the multi-objective portfolio model, incorporating risk factors and optimism factors into consideration, the Genetic Algorithm provides the trading strategy. By comparing the model output returns with the actual returns, our 5-year prediction error rate is 9% with a high accuracy rate, and the annualized return rate reaches 39%. Secondly, this paper evaluates and builds a trading strategy model from the perspectives of risk and return. The BWM method is used to solve the weight problem in multi-dimensional decision-making.

articleTitle: A Feasibility of 3-D Microwave Forward Modelling Simplification based on Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The forward problem plays an important role in microwave inversion, but numerical (3-D) forward modeling methods are usually computationally expensive, limiting the inversion efficiency. This paper provides a simplified method based on the Back Propagation (BP) neural network for 3-D forward modeling. The simplification is realized based on a 2-D simulation and BP neural network hybrid procedure. The field data at receivers in 3-D problems. 2-D and 3-D simulations are made to generate synthetic data. A BP neural network mapping 2-D data to 3-D data is established, trained, and tested with the generated data. The average prediction accuracy is less than 2%. The average time cost is primarily reduced to 1% of 3-D simulation. This method can be applied to 3-D microwave imaging applications for fast inversion.

articleTitle: Research on R-wave recognition method for ECG signal in the optimized firing process
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: R wave, as an important reference for determining each band of ECG signal, is the premise of ECG automatic analysis. In view of the problem that the preprocessing process of most R-wave recognition algorithms affects the recognition accuracy, a new R-wave recognition method based on the combination of wavelet transform and adaptive threshold method is proposed, which improves the stability and accuracy of R-wave recognition. Firstly, the ECG signal is decomposed based on wavelet, and the 2<sup>3</sup>rd layer wavelet signal is obtained. Then the sliding window width and initial threshold are set. The threshold is adjusted according to the signal situation and the window width is increased to quickly identify the <tex>$R$</tex> wave. Finally, the simulation results show that the algorithm is effective in R-wave recognition of heart rate variability ECG signal during shooting.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Technology and Computer Aided Technology in Product Design
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: From the perspective of application, this paper expounds the application of computer big data-aided design in each stage of mechanical product design and the corresponding auxiliary tools. In this paper, CAD, CAM and MIS systems are integrated into the enterprise local area network so that enterprise clusters can share. This enables FMSs producing the same or similar family of parts to obtain production data directly from the integrated system. This paper presents a model of a computer-aided innovation design platform. As a computer-aided tool, the platform can perform a complete product innovation design process, including problem analysis, strategic solution, knowledge data support, and program management evaluation. This paper introduces the role of each functional module in product innovation design and the tools used. This paper develops the corresponding functional modules of the prototype system based on Java technology. The operation process of the system is illustrated by an example and its integrity and feasibility are verified.

articleTitle: Research on multi-traveling salesman problem based on simulated annealing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As an extension of the traveling salesman problem, the multi-traveling salesman problem is also a typical NP hard problem, but it has wider practical significance. In the past, most of the research on solving the multi-travel salesman problem was limited to the minimum sum of all travel salesman paths as the optimization standard. In this paper, based on the constraints of the minimum travel quotient, the path balance among travel agents, and the time window traversing the city, a mathematical model was established to optimize the multi-travel salesman path using the improved simulated annealing algorithm. The feasibility of the algorithm is verified by a simulation example, and it meets the requirements of real-time performance.

articleTitle: Simulation of Sea Clutter Data Based on DPOS-CFAR Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The classical Log-t-CFAR dual parameter detector has CFAR performance for both scale parameters and shape parameters. Compared with the single parameter CFAR detector, it has stronger clutter adaptability, but there are some problems, such as large false alarm loss and a large amount of computation. In this paper, feedback control is applied to CFAR detection. Based on OS-CFAR, a dual parameter ordered statistics (DPOS) CFAR detector with feedback control is proposed, which solves the problem of large false alarm loss of dual parameter CFAR detector. Its performance is analyzed and verified by actual sea clutter data simulation. The simulation results show that the detection performance of the DPOS-CFAR detector is better than that of the classical dual parameter detector.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Training System of Athletes Assisted by Computer and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Collection work is the key to the training level of athletes in the process of track and field sports training. This paper applies the idea of multi-sensor to information fusion technology. In this paper, the critical indicators of athletes are collected through multiple sensors and cameras. The former is to use wavelet transform to realize the feature extraction of human surface EMG signals. Then this paper uses the artificial neural network method to identify the key features to get the preliminary track and field evaluation results. The research found that this method can measure the training rotation angle, motion characteristic data trajectory, speed, acceleration, and other indicators in real-time and accurately determine the difference. The motion acquisition technology proposed in this paper can correct bad habits and improve the training level.

articleTitle: Underwater Transmission of Digital Image in Wireless Optical Communication Based on Single Photon Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Based on the circular polarization multiplexing technology of single photon detection, the digital image is transmitted in the water channel with transmission distance of 13.42m and attenuation coefficient of 0.24m<sup>-1</sup> through source coding and error correction coding. The influence of photon number on transmission bit error rate (BER) and frame loss rate is studied, and how to reduce the bit error rate and frame loss rate through error correction and software processing.

articleTitle: Research on base station site selection in power wireless private network based on improved NSGA-2 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of base station site selection in power wireless private network, this paper proposes a site selection optimization scheme using an improved NSGA-2 algorithm and Atoll simulation. The scheme is divided into two parts. Firstly, the base station type and network parameters are designed. Then the NSGA-2 algorithm based on reference point selection is used for the final site selection. The framework of the location algorithm is given. The construction cost, fiber access location and effective coverage are considered. The final base station construction site is given. The feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme are verified by simulation, which provides an effective reference for the construction of power wireless private network.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling and Simulation of Mixed Traffic Flow under Turn Signal and Honk Effect
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To study the influence of turn signal and honk in the mixed traffic flow including motor vehicle, electric bike and bike, a four-lane cellular automata model is established. The motor vehicle turns on the turn signal before changing lane, which can decelerate the latter vehicle on the adjacent lane. The motor vehicle can honk to make the preceding electric bike change lane, which is called 'the first-honk‘. Besides, the electric bike can honk to make the preceding bike change lane, which is called 'the second-honk‘. The simulation results show that the turn signal effect and honk can significantly reduce obstruction in space-time diagram. The turn signal effect decreases the motor vehicle flow, but two honk effects can increase it. The turn signal effect and the second-honk improve the non-motor vehicle flow, but the first-honk reduces it. The density section in which these effects occur frequently is very different.

articleTitle: Visualization system for the distribution of noise inside subway trains along the line section
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Subway vehicle interior noise greatly affects the health and ride comfort of subway operators and passengers. There are various problems in traditional noise monitoring and evaluation, such as large amount of noise data, complicated processing and low efficiency, monotonous expression, limited social service area and so on. In order to overcome the above problems, the author has proposed a method for visualizing the distribution of the subway vehicle interior noise along the line intervals. On this basis, a set of noise distribution visualization system was designed, and a spatial-temporal data visualization platform of in-vehicle noise was built with the MySQL to realize the visual monitoring and evaluation of the distribution of subway vehicle interior noise along the line.

articleTitle: Research on Java-based library management system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The book management system pays more attention to light weight. Managers only need to perform simple operations to complete the operation of adding, deleting, modifying, and checking book categories and the operations of adding, deleting, modifying and checking books in the same category. This paper studies a book management system based on C/S, using Eclipse as the development environment, using Sqlyog as the database server, and based on the Java language. The system has the characteristics of fast running speed, high security and strong portability.

articleTitle: An ant colony algorithm-based siting model for campus substitute pickup courier sites
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The rapid development of e-commerce makes the express business grow rapidly, but the construction of infrastructure cannot keep up with the growth rate of express business. so, the express terminal express receiving volume is always in a high load operation state. For this problem, the current universal solution is to set up an express network. The recipient unified to receive express network, but the express network, especially the express network in the university campus is also gradually. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes the setting of courier pick-up site program, the site selection through the ant colony algorithm, followed by the determination of the distribution plan based on the logistics cost calculation model. The site selection and distribution plan evaluation system for theoretical analysis of different site selection decisions, and finally determine the optimal courier pick-up site location plan, and solve the rapid growth of courier business caused by the overload of courier terminals. The problem of overloading of express terminals caused by the rapid growth of express business is solved.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of 5G Communication Technology in the Development of Computer Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The article proposes a 5G-oriented cellular Internet of Things architecture, which separates the transport layer and the edge computing layer, and decouples the fog computing and cloud computing layers. The article discusses the functions of each layer and analyses the data flow in the network architecture. At the end of the article, a demodulation test of the cellular IoT signal is carried out. The results show that the cellular Internet of Things has the characteristics of low speed, wide coverage and low power consumption, which can better meet the needs of Internet of Things applications, and has reference significance for 5G cellular Internet of Things applications.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement and Noise Suppression for Optical Coherence Tomography Images based on Variational Image Decomposition and Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images often suffer from low contrast and severe speckle noise. For such need, this work presents a new image enhancement and noise suppression method for OCT images. A new variational image decomposition (VID) model TV-Hilbert-Curvelet is proposed in order to decompose the OCT image into three part: structure, background and noise. And the gaussian mixture model (GMM) is used to generate one binary mask template from the background part, the multi scale Retinex (MSR) is used to enhance the structure part. Experimental results show that the proposed method can enhance the image structure and suppress speckle noise well, and three quality indexes are used to verify the experimental results of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research of Investment Decision based on the Coupling Model of Metabolic AR and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper predicts the price of gold and bitcoin through the combination of time series Metabolic AR model and neural network model. AR can solve the problem of insufficient data in the early stage, and neural networks can improve the accuracy of prediction in the later stage. We also add financial risk analysis, combine forecast price and trading commission information, and optimize investment risk weights by entropy weighting method to get the final investment model. It is assumed a starting value of $1,000 for cash investments between September 11, 2016, and September 10, 2021. The investment model results show that the price predictions are very close to the actual results, with $38,232.66 worth of investments for $1,000 cash. In addition, RMSE is used to calculate the residuals. It is surprising that the expected yield of the model is 107.25%, far exceeding one of Treasury bonds and VC, and the results show that the RMSE value of gold is 85.5, which is acceptable, which is indicated that the portfolio model is good.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of campus bike rental system from the perspective of sharing economy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In college campus life under the perspective of sharing economy, private bikes bought by teachers and students are easy to become idle resources, resulting in resource waste, traffic congestion and other problems. In view of these problems, this paper proposes and develops a university campus bike rental system on the basis of sharing economy. Through comprehensive use of Vue technology, MySQL, UNI-app, SpringBoot and other tools, the overall framework of the bike rental system based on the perspective of sharing economy is designed, developed and implemented. The practical results prove that the system can fully realize all the functions, not only to meet the needs of users, but also improve the utilization rate of campus bike resources, improve the bike sharing market in fewer types, rental time and trouble to investigate the responsibility and other shortcomings.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction System of Language Service Platform based on Computer Corpus
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The language service platform is an online platform that provides real-time language services for enterprises and individuals. The demanders can obtain the required language services quickly and find professional language services immediately, saving time and effort. A language service platform was built based on client/server. The platform includes online, photo, manual translation and language selection. The service platform builds a corpus, provides standardized services and realizes applications with multiple interaction methods for multi-platform devices. The online translation uses Python to crawl data and implements corpus services through the. NET platform; manual translation builds an artificial translation module through the. NET platform and uses WebAPI to provide external services. The language service platform is part of the national language capacity, essential in promoting international economic and cultural exchanges.

articleTitle: Low-Dose Mouse Micro-CT Image Segmentation Based on Multi-Resolution Multi-Organ Shape Prior Knowledge Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Automatic segmentation of computed tomography (CT) images of mice is a step toward computer-assisted preclinical image analysis. Due to the low image quality of micro-CT images, fully-automatic methods may not achieve robust segmentation. For this reason, human interventions are needed to achieve higher segmentation accuracy. In this paper, we propose a human interactive segmentation method incorporating anatomical prior knowledge for multiple abdominal organs in mouse micro-CT images. The method automatically fits a multi-organ shape model to the user-sketched partial boundary contours. Segmentation accuracy is validated by comparing the proposed method against existing shape models. The robustness of our proposed method was evaluated with different users. Finally, the results suggest the proposed method generates accurate segmentation with good robustness.

articleTitle: Research on the application of online teaching information intelligent interaction system based on virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Based on the virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) technologies, the virtual reality interactive model platform for online teaching of engineering graphics is developed using Unity3D development platform, 3ds MAX, UV modeling software and C# interactive programming tools. The platform's underlying design, functional and technical development scheme, content design, and management strategy of the platform are introduced in detail. The platform can give full play to the respective advantages of VR and AR technologies, which can help overcome the obstacles in model display and interaction in online teaching of engineering drawing courses and provide a useful trial and exploration for the information construction of engineering drawing courses.

articleTitle: Solar Energy Materials and Solar Cells Applications with Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper makes an economic plan for using solar energy to provide power for a 1600-square-foot house in a remote area. Given the basic information of household population, total power consumption of household appliances, and different types of batteries, according to the actual power consumption of the owner, a model is established by using the particle swarm optimization algorithm for dynamic programming to select the energy storage system. For example, considering the type of battery and the number of batteries, with the help of the model, the best option for the off-grid house is to obtain enough energy to support the house's energy demand at night and on cloudy days. It also describes some advantages and disadvantages of cement energy storage as a new building material and suggestions on the future possibility of cement batteries.

articleTitle: Analysis on Password Attack Model and Password Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Identity authentication is an important line of defense of network security, password has long been the mainstream way of identity authentication, password attack plays an important role in password security research. Probabilistic Context Free Grammar (PCFG) and the Markov chain-based model are the two most effective password attack methods. They can effectively model and describe the password from the substructure composition level and the character dependence level, respectively. This paper first analyzes the various encryption algorithms for cryptographic database, which are currently mainstream, and describes the comparison and strength of these algorithms. Moreover, this paper analyzes the current cipher structure within the password database. At last, this paper briefly describes the current method of password attacks and focuses on three most important methods, including Markov chain, OMEN algorithm and context-independent, to crack the password. This paper discusses the development of these three algorithms in current academic field, including the Recursive-OMEN algorithm based on structure partition and string reorganization, Adam algorithm based on dictionary attack, and genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Interactive Practice System of Mathematics Online Classroom Under Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the image of binary function in advanced mathematics teaching is difficult to visually present its morphological characteristics and the geometric meaning of related knowledge points in the traditional way, this paper designs and implements a three-dimensional dynamic auxiliary teaching system for advanced mathematics based on computer artificial intelligence technology. The system developed basic experimental teaching, comprehensive experimental teaching and display WebApp templates. At the same time, the system realizes the deep integration of online teaching, experimental practice and interactive demonstration. This system effectively solves the problem of high interactive demand of virtual experiment teaching, and fully enhances the intelligent interactive learning experience of learners.

articleTitle: Fused Attention Decoder in End-to-End Model with Complex Scenes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Recognition of text in images is a practical technique that has been studied for decades. However, the recently recognition algorithms in complex scenes still have difficulties such as high computational cost and vanishing gradients. This paper proposes a fused End-to-End Attention Decoder image text recognition structure to search for the best character center points and character attention features by using fused shared features in the detection-recognition modules. Our experiments on dataset show that the proposed fused attention model could enhance the performance index of the recognizer, especially to better predict text location and content information in irregular scene images.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Medical System of TCM Informatization Rehabilitation under Computer Intelligent Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: as a practical tool, the expert system of Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment is an effective means for human beings to preserve, disseminate, use and evaluate the knowledge of Chinese medicine. This paper proposes an ideological method of TCM data mining research. This paper encapsulates TCM problems and data mining methods to achieve a unified interface. The system realizes accurate, intelligent analysis and remote transmission of TCM pulse. Combined with the simultaneous upload of tongue image photos and medical history data, patients can obtain services such as remote consultation, follow-up consultation, prescription conditioning, drug delivery to home, or nearby drug collection without leaving home. In this paper, the remote TCM intelligent pulse diagnosis system and mobile family doctor platform can overcome the obstacles brought by time and space to the repeated consultation and conditioning prescription of traditional Chinese medicine. At the same time, this is also an effective way to implement the remote follow-up consultation and family doctor model in traditional Chinese medicine.

articleTitle: Research on Automobile HMI Scene Experience Based on Big Data Intelligent Computing and Density Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Consumers' requirements for automobile HMI are no longer simple functional requirements, but higher-level scene experience and spiritual needs. Therefore, to measure whether a car's HMI is easy to use, we need to build an evaluation system in combination with the scene and consumers' needs. From the perspective of consumer demand, this paper uses big data text clustering analysis, factor analysis and other methods to build HMI experience evaluation system in the scene, build evaluation indicators and analyze the weight of indicators, and apply the evaluation system to analyze the experience evaluation, advantages and disadvantages of representative models, and explore the development trend of HMI.

articleTitle: An improved GM(1,1) model based on iterative weighted least square criterion parameter estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The least square method is used in the traditional grey model to estimate the model's structural parameters, but it has limitations in predicting time series with outliers, and the robustness of the model needs to be modified. Therefore, a new method is proposed to estimate the structural parameters of grey model based on the weighted iterative least square method in order to reduce the sensitivity of the traditional least square method in parameter estimation to improve the robustness of traditional grey GM(1, 1) model and its fitting ability in samples containing sensitive information. The grey RGM(1, 1) model's establishment process is described based on the iterative weighted least squares criterion, and the specific weighted iterative least squares steps are used to estimate structural parameters. A state grid company's equipment maintenance cost prediction shows that robust GM(1, 1) has a higher prediction accuracy than the traditional GM(1, 1) grey model. In this paper, the iterative weighted least squares algorithm of structural parameters expands the statistical connotation of grey theory to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Method of Auxiliary Expert Talents Based on Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Talent evaluation is an important part for our country to discover outstanding talents, to allocate human resources according to market, to motivate innovation and entrepreneurship. At present, domestic talent evaluation is mostly carried out in the traditional organizational expert mode, and there is huge space for improvement in efficiency and cost. Based on multiple batches of structured candidate talent index data, this study uses an integrated learning model to simulate and predict talent scores, which can assist experts on their work and improve assessment efficiency. Results from our experiments show, even in the case of small data sets, the scoring process based on our model can have the average error about 6 percentage between the predicted score and the actual score, and the error can be further reduced when the amount of data increase.

articleTitle: Design of Face Recognition System based on Linux
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Face recognition technology was born as a biological characteristic because of advantages such as being difficult to counterfeit, having a high recognition degree, being portable, and not losing. This design is based on the Linux operating system, and it includes an AI chip with inbuilt NPU integration and a high-performance video processing master chip that can analyze and process video data gathered by the sensor module, as well as perform real-time face recognition. In addition, using the RSTP protocol, the collected data can be displayed in real time on a web page, completing the man-machine interaction.

articleTitle: Intelligent ventilation remote practice system based on cloud platform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Based on the current situation of practical education in Colleges, for the purpose of cultivating the practical ability of mine ventilation, this paper summarizes a remote interactive “intelligent ventilation remote practice system”. This system integrates the virtual experiment system and ventilation experiment model, constructs a cloud practical learning platform, provides students with a series of ventilation practical learning resources, and simulates the offline practical learning process to the greatest extent. It is mainly composed of physical experiment module, electrical control module and cloud control module. Combined with experimental model and virtual experiment platform, the system fully combines traditional and virtual teaching methods to promote students' effective learning.

articleTitle: Research on Practical Application and Optimization of Multi-Strategy Prediction Method Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In this paper, through the method of mathematical modeling, based on the practical application of the prediction model for research and mathematical modeling. First of all, based on literature research, this paper puts forward the basic prediction model and takes several high-precision algorithms based on statistics and machine learning as the sub-modules of the prediction model. We integrate multiple predictions provided by the sub-module and provide the final prediction through the integration. Then the prediction is regarded as a planning problem, and the index quantity of the optimal weight is introduced into the optimization objective to predict and get better results.

articleTitle: High-Performance, All-Scenario COVID-19 Pathogen Detection, Prevention, and Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Given the COVID-19 pandemic, this paper aims at providing a full-process information system to support the detection of pathogens for a large range of populations, satisfying the requirements of light weight, low cost, high concurrency, high reliability, quick response, and high security. The project includes functional modules such as sample collection, sample transfer, sample reception, laboratory testing, test result inquiry, pandemic analysis, and monitoring. The progress and efficiency of each collection point as well as the status of sample transfer, reception, and laboratory testing are all monitored in real time, in order to support the comprehensive surveillance of the pandemic situation and support the dynamic deployment of pandemic prevention resources in a timely and effective manner. Deployed on a cloud platform, this system can satisfy ultra-high concurrent data collection requirements with 20 million collections per day and a maximum of 5 million collections per hour, due to its advantages of high concurrency, elasticity, security, and manageability. This system has also been widely used in Jiangsu, Shaanxi provinces, for the prevention and control of COVID-19 pandemic. Over 100 million NAT data have been collected nationwide, providing strong informational support for scientific and reasonable formulation and execution of COVID-19 prevention plans.

articleTitle: Research on Career Guidance Course System based on Apriori Algorithm and Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of unsmooth information and difficulty in statistical analysis of information in the employment guidance work of college students, the article uses Visual Fox-Pro to program, designs a data verification program, and realizes the function of data intelligent proofreading. Secondly, the article applies the Apriori algorithm in data mining technology, takes university employment history data as the research object, and takes the student employment guidance as the research purpose. Through the mining of university employment data, it finds the internal factors that affect the employment of students, and discovers the education attributes and education attributes of students. The correlation between employment attributes. Through the actual test of the optimization algorithm, the generation of a large number of meaningless association rules can be avoided and the mining efficiency can be improved.

articleTitle: An Innovative Decision Support Approach to Measure the Propagation of Systemic Risk Using Granger Causality Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Based on the return time series data of China's A-share market, this paper uses the Granger causality test method to construct a risk contagion network between companies and a risk contagion network between provinces. Based on the constructed network, the degree of risk spillover in Shanghai is analyzed. According to the ranking, the top three provinces in China most affected by the financial risk of the Shanghai are Guangdong Province, Zhejiang Province, and Jiangsu Province.

articleTitle: Design of fire information transmission unit based on energy storage power station
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: According to the data acquisition requirements of automatic fire detection system and monitoring system of energy storage power station, an embedded data acquisition device based on arm in embedded Linux environment is designed and developed. The device itself supports 100 MLC optical fiber interface, 10 m /100 m adaptive RJ45 electric port and 8-way RS485 communication interface. At the same time, it can realize 8-way <tex>$4\sim 20 \ \text{mA}$</tex> signal acquisition and calculation and 2-way can communication interface through arm processor, and effectively suppress power frequency interference. Support the traditional communication protocols of power system, such as modbus, CDT, 103, 101 / 104, and the communication protocols of intelligent substation, such as IEC61850, MMS and goose. The unit module realizes the real-time upload and distribution of fire information.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Judgment of Financial Aid for Poor Students based on Improved K-means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The determination of poor students in colleges and universities is a problem that has long plagued the management of colleges and universities. Since the issuance of grants is related to the vital interests of poor students, it is particularly important to correctly identify poor students. It is necessary to dig out the hidden information in the consumption data to put forward scientific basis for the determination of poor students. In this paper, the K-means algorithm is sensitive to the initial clustering center and the same weight of each attribute. A weighted Euclidean distance algorithm based on average density and the longest distance is proposed, and the improved algorithm is applied to the clustering of campus card consumption data. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm has higher clustering accuracy and more stable clustering results. Finally, with students' academic performance linked to the level of consumption, consumption habits and academic performance-related data, access to poor students auxiliary judgment criteria, and then put forward scientific decision-making recommendations to managers.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Online Teaching based on SPSS Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to study the overall situation of college English online teaching and students' online learning satisfaction during the COVID-19 epidemic, this paper made a questionnaire from four aspects: learning environment, teachers' teaching activities, students' learning activities, and online learning effect. Through SPSS23.0 software, the questionnaire data were analyzed by reliability analysis, validity analysis, principal component analysis, regression analysis and other methods, and the impacts of learning environment, teaching activities, learning activities, learning evaluation on students' learning satisfaction were studied.

articleTitle: Prediction of American Automobile Pricing based on Quantitative Analysis of Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of the epoch, automobiles have become irreplaceable transportation in people's daily lives. It is becoming more worldwide for more automakers to sell vehicles to other regions with the development of economic globalization. Setting a reasonable price not only helps consumers to make feasible choices but also benefits the sales of automakers.
