By establishing a regression model, a relative analysis of pricing is carried out. This article studies the price of the U.S automobile by evaluating 275 groups of relative data on Kaggle. In addition, other papers have been investigated to find the optimal algorithm. Afterward, other distinct models are compared, such as Gradient boosting, Lasso regression, Ridge regression, and the random forest. Moreover, several graphs are plotted, including a heat map, a scatter graph, a normal distribution plot, and two box plots to scrutinize the scale of the influence of features on prices. By pre-processing and dimensionality reduction of the data, the length and width of the car, and the fuel emissions of the car are found also have an important impact on the price. According to the investigation, the Gradient boosting, R2 is 0.9722 and RMSE is 1465.04, performs the paramount among the three sets of fitted models.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Research on the Model of Equipment Theory Learning based on Tabu Search-Parallel Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In view of the characteristics of teaching and training tasks in military academies, a Tabu Search-parallel Genetic Algorithms is proposed in this paper, and the model of equipment theory learning is studied based on this algorithm. The algorithm can greatly improve the operation efficiency and convergence, and can realize fast retrieval and matching. It plays a key role in the establishment of learning model, and provides technical support for the development of equipment theory learning system in the next step.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Information Reminder System in Employment Assistance Information System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper proposes the design goals of the graduate employment management system based on systematically analyzing the requirements of the school employment management information system. This paper discusses the architecture design of the graduate employment management system based on the Web and designs the main functional modules such as the standard module, graduate module, enterprise user module, and administrator module of the system. The system implements personal information management, job search information viewing, career guidance and learning, recruitment information release, and administrators' management of users.

articleTitle: Research on the simulation and optimization of enterprise information factory graphics based on computer 3D technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The rapid development of computer technology has led more and more enterprises to enter the era of information-based production management. Virtual reality technology and digital factory, as an important part of enterprise information construction, have been accepted by more and more enterprises, and have played an important economic benefit in it. In this paper, based on virtual reality technology, three modules of layout simulation, process planning and logistics simulation of the digital factory are analyzed, and simulation models are constructed, and optimization schemes are proposed. Through experimental simulation, the utilization rate of each equipment and the quantity of finished products in the production plant were compared and analyzed. The simulation results show that the optimized scheme improves the actual production capacity and productivity of the workshop and saves the cost of investment, thus proving the effectiveness of the optimized scheme.

articleTitle: ANN-Based Integrated Multi-Objective Investment Decision Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Gold and Bitcoin are two volatile assets that market traders frequently purchase. In order to maximize returns, market traders want us to develop a model that uses past daily price data to determine daily scenarios for buying, holding, or selling assets in their portfolios. This paper focuses on a portfolio investment strategy for gold and bitcoin, providing a comprehensive model for investment forecasting and decision making, combining a variety of economic indicators, and using sensitivity analysis and hierarchical analysis to analyze and evaluate the model. This article divides the investment model into two parts[1]: the prediction and decision models. For the prediction model, we constructed a time series model based on artificial neural network (ANN), and after training a large amount of data, the model has excellent prediction accuracy with the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 2.842%, and root mean square error (RMSE) of 7.203, which is much more accurate than other models. For the decision model, this article introduced evaluation indexes such as relative strength index (RSI), confidence interval of normal distribution, and prediction risk rate as the basis for decision making, and gave a generic logic for judging buying and selling operations, a detailed classification of all possible situations, and a treatment plan for each situation. In order to evaluate our model, we introduce five evaluation indicators: RMSE, MAPE, average annualized return, final return, and Sharpe ratio. The average annualized return of the model is 26.165%, the Sharpe ratio is 1.147, and the final return of the investment is $2945.48, which is an excellent performance. In addition, we also calculated the evaluation indexes of backpropagation neural network (BP) and support vector machines(SVM) participation forecasting models and used hierarchical analysis to evaluate these three forecasting models. After calculation and comparison, the final ANN forecasting model scored 0.407, which was at the top of the three models.

articleTitle: Detecting Misogynia in Italian Tweets: A Linguistic and Contextual based Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Social media provides a platform for people to freely share their lives and feelings. However, with the increase of people's use of social media, the dark side of social media has gradually attracted people's attention. The anonymity of social media has led many people to use it to harass, abuse, and attack others, with women being a common target group. Twitter, one of the world's most well-known social media platforms, is used by hundreds of millions of people worldwide to communicate and share information every day. Although the artificial intelligence system for detecting hate comments has been applied to the maintenance of social media, it is still difficult to distinguish hate speech against women. That is because misogynistic comments are often subtle, and the currently commonly applied detection methods do not sufficiently consider the contextual information of the text. Therefore, we propose a BERT-based misogyny detection method that can fully integrate contextual information and context to classify texts. The experimental results show that our method has significant improvement compared with other methods.

articleTitle: Optimal battery selection for solar storage system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Nowadays, the extreme conjunction forces people who lived in the urban area to leave for a more leisurely living place in the remote area. However, this comes up with the problems that people who live in the rural area suffer from the inconvenience of electricity shortage. Building up a solar energy storage system and choosing a suitable battery seems to be necessary for them. As a result, our team decided to build up a highly applicable model to help users determine their most suitable batteries. We developed an Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) model and a Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) model to solve the best battery selection for a solar energy storing system problem. This problem involves many decisive factors and cannot be settled unless all of these factors, including attributes of the batteries, applicable situation, and users' preferences, are comprehensively considered. In our solution, various kinds of on-sale batteries are evaluated from a total of 9 criteria in six aspects: cost, battery's safety, continuous power rating, instantaneous power rating, round-Trip efficiency, and usable capacity. The cost of the battery is the most important factor affecting battery choice. Battery's safety refers to the safe level of the batteries, such as whether it will blow out during working. Continuous power rating means the output power of the battery, which allows it to operate continuously for a long time under the environmental conditions specified in the current relevant standards. Instantaneous power rating refers to the instantaneous power released by the battery. Round-trip efficiency is how much electricity a battery could generate in a single round-trip circuit. Usable capacity refers to the length of the battery's usable time. Both battery properties and user situation/preferences are fully considered in the model. Therefore, this model can recommend the best battery based on users' situations/preferences. The model is validated using eight batteries and ten fictional people in different careers. The best battery will be recommended with the highest rating, and all other seven batteries are ranked according to their computed priorities, providing more battery options for users.

articleTitle: An efficient automatic scoring algorithm based on SQL code
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the nonstandard and imprecise evaluation of SQL (Structured Query Language) code in database teaching, an automatic scoring model of SQL code is established. Firstly, the model preprocesses the SQL code, analyzes the semantic structure, extracts the characteristics of the code, and performs word segmentation at the same time; Then build the synonym Library of SQL code, and convert the code fragments after word segmentation according to the synonym library; Then the longest common substring algorithm is used to match the similarity of code fragments, and then the influence factors of each fragment are given to obtain the total similarity of code; Finally, analyze the manual scoring data and formulate the corresponding automatic scoring strategy, so as to evaluate the score of SQL code. The model constructs a synonym database for the first time, which effectively improves the scoring efficiency of SQL code and can reach a more accurate level. Circular matching can also score long codes in SQL.

articleTitle: Computer intelligent prediction model of resisting dust storms based on entropy weight method and time series
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: According to the data selected, six evaluation indicators such as gas emission index, pollution load index, biological abundance index, land degradation index, vegetation cover index, and water network density index were used as the basis for scoring. In order to reduce the subjectivity of indicator selection and enhance the objectivity, the weight occupied by each indicator in the re-evaluation system was obtained by entropy weighting method in order to make full use of the original data. Then the TOPSIS evaluation model was established based on the index weights. Through MATLAB programming, for each year, the scoring judgment was performed. Quantitative analysis of the impact on the environment after restoration of the Seyhan Dam and the environmental conditions before and after restoration of the Seyhan Dam. Correlation analysis was performed between the index data of Seyhan Dam and the data of Beijing dust storms to find the functional relationship between each factor. And time series analysis was performed. In order to get the accuracy of the solution, for the fitted function of the correlation analysis, the variance was used to determine whether it was in a reasonable fitting interval then the entropy weighting method used in problem one was used to assign weights to the analyzed functions so as to get more objective scoring evaluation criteria. And finally, more accurate quantitative analysis data were obtained through MATLAB programming to quantitatively evaluate the role of the Sehanba Forestry in the protection against sandstorms in Beijing.

articleTitle: Research and Statistical Analysis on Mathematical Model of Manufacturing Digital Maturity Evaluation and Its Impact on Transformation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of digital transformation and upgrading of Chinese manufacturing enterprises, it is more and more important to measure the digital level of Chinese manufacturing enterprises and find the key factors for improving the digital capabilities of enterprises. This paper studies the object-oriented simulation modeling method of digital manufacturing system through the planning, modeling and simulation analysis of discrete manufacturing system. At the same time, this paper constructs a digital maturity evaluation model of manufacturing enterprises from four dimensions: strategy, operational technology, cultural organization capability, and ecosystem. The study found that the digital maturity score of the case car companies was 1.00. The research conclusions of this paper provide a technical basis for the comprehensive realization of digital manufacturing engineering management.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Credit Risk Factors of Small and Medium Enterprises Based on Grey Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To explore the credit risk factors of SMEs, this paper analyses and studies 25 financial indicators reflecting the financial status and business results of enterprises based on grey systems and artificial neural networks-multilayer perceptron (ANN-MLP). The indicators were downscaled using grey integrated correlation to find the 10 indicators that are most closely related to credit. The neural network was trained by combining the financial data of 27home enterprises to construct a credit evaluation index system for SMEs consisting of 10 indicators. The results show that the training accuracy of the established ANN-MLP is 91.7% after passing the training, and the SME credit evaluation index system established in this paper has certain accuracy. The research results are of great reference significance to improving the credit risk identification ability of banks for SMEs.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Artificial Intelligence Virtual Timbre and Digital Audio System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Virtual equalizer is one of the important tools for audio system tuning. This paper introduces the design of digital audio equalizer based on virtual hardware platform. Its audio algorithm includes spectrum analysis and balancing. Tests have shown that the system can achieve the desired tone balance, allowing users to select and customize a variety of sound effects.

articleTitle: Research on Quantitative Trading Strategy based on LSTM and Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To get the most bang for the buck, market traders always trade a combination of volatile assets frequently in a short period, such as the combination of gold and bitcoin. This paper establishes a trading strategy model with quantitative risk assessment using machine learning and heuristic algorithms to obtain maximum returns when frequently trading this portfolio. And then guide traders to make investment decisions. First, we build a predictive model. We build a price prediction model based on LSTM neural network. Using LSTM can effectively convey and express information in long time series and not cause useful information long ago to be ignored. Better forecasting performance in financial time series. Then, we build a decision model. We have established quantitative trading strategies based on dynamic programming. Based on the prediction, we established a multi-objective dynamic programming model that maximizes returns under the premise of ensuring low risk. We use it to simulate and record the proportion of assets when the maximum return is obtained in each cycle to accelerate the function.

articleTitle: Prediction of FCEV ownership in China based on the improvement of the GM(1,1) using genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of forecasting the Ownership of FCEV in China, this paper optimizes the GM(1,1) by using exponential smoothing and genetic algorithm, and verifies that the improved GM(1,1) is more suitable for forecasting the Ownership of FCEV in China through the data of the Ownership of FCEV in China from 2017 to 2021. Finally, the best model is used to forecast the Ownership of FCEV in China from 2022 to 2026.

articleTitle: Effects of different algorithms, number of users and frequency channel allocation on fractional frequency reuse performance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The increase of wireless devices increases the demand for data throughput, which requires mobile operators to reduce inter-cell interference to build ultra-dense network. Fractional frequency reuse is a widely used frequency allocation method, which can reduce inter-cell interference. In this paper, four different frequency allocation algorithms of integer frequency reuse (IFR), simultaneous water filling (SWF), transmit interference temperature limit (tx-ITL) and forward-looking game (FLG) are adopted for the edge area in FFR under 19-cell network. By calculating the capacity of different systems, the performance of different algorithms applied to edge area is compared. It is concluded that when these four algorithms are applied to edge area, the order of performance from good to bad is FLG > tx-ITL = SWF > IFRN. In addition, this paper also studies the impact of the average number of cell users on the system capacity. It is found that the average number of users can increase the system capacity to a certain extent, but it will bring some hidden dangers at the same time. Finally, in the FFR system, the research on the ratio of the number of internal frequency channels to the system performance is also included. Some suggestions on the allocation of frequency channels in the inner and outer regions are also put forward. These works may provide some help for the research on how to improve the capacity of cellular mobile communication system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Crosstalk of Communication Cable in Metro Network Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the crosstalk problem of metro network control communication cable, a crosstalk model based on the theory of MTL is established, and a calculation method for distribution parameters of shielded cables in a homogeneous medium is also given. FDTD is used to discretize transmission line in time and space, and iterative model of time-domain coupling response of communication cable is derived by correcting the voltage and current at the twisted part of the cable. Finally, factors that affect crosstalk are simulated, and results show that crosstalk is inversely proportional to the distance between lines and is directly proportional to the height from ground and the coupling length; for shielding layer, double-end grounding has the strongest anti-interference ability, non-grounding end has a significant interference during single-end grounding, and double-end floating has a worse anti-interference effect.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Self-Regulated Learning System for Equipment Theoretical Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: According to the characteristics of the current equipment theory courses in the military academy and the needs of cadet, this paper studies and designs a set of self-regulated learning system for equipment theoretical knowledge whose operation function is based on Tabu Search-Parallel Genetic Algorithms (TPGA). The basic framework and functional composition of the system are constructed, and the system operation process and software interface are designed. It has been verified that the search and matching efficiency of the new algorithm has been greatly improved so that it can meet the requirements of the system which can provide technical support and example reference for further research and development of other learning systems.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Sports Information System under Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper designs a college sports information management system based on the use of big data. This paper designs the cloud architecture of the system according to the overall functional requirements of the system and builds the data management architecture according to the data processing requirements. This paper designs the overall architecture of the supervisory end according to the needs of supervisors and explores the management methods that supervisors can achieve through this supervisory end. This paper discusses the management method of students' exercise time, exercise volume and exercise intensity by using the information management system. Such a platform makes the mobile device terminal, server terminal and PC terminal an organic whole; through the information management of teaching, clubs, after-school exercise, and venues, the integration of campus sports resources is realized.

articleTitle: Recent advances in deep learning based computer vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Deep learning is a hot topic in current AI research and significant progress has been made in a variety of fields, including computer vision and natural language processing. Traditional architecture of deep learning normally based on convolutional neural networks. In recent years, impressive results from Transformer models on natural language tasks have intrigued the vision community to study their application to computer vision problems. Thus, neural networks with Transformer architecture have been introduced to computer vision tasks and even challenge mainstream of traditional convolutional neural network. In this paper, it will review recent improvements in computer vision based on deep learning method. It'll go over some of the most important research in deep learning models. After that, it focus on advances in four key computer vision tasks: picture classification, object identification, semantic segmentation, and human posture estimation. It'll go through the most recent developments in these fields. Finally, it will provide a conclution of recent computer vision advances and discuss future possibility.

Index Terms: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge

articleTitle: Smart toothbrush app user interface usability study
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To improve the design quality of its human-computer interaction interface and explore its usability. This paper takes the smart toothbrush APP user interface as the research object and uses a combination of questionnaire research and experimentation to obtain data on the original user requirements. Firstly, the Kano model is used to extract the functional requirements of the smart toothbrush app, and the extracted functional requirements are analyzed for satisfaction to determine the priority of the expected functional requirements. Secondly, based on Nielsen et al.'s usability evaluation framework and combined with the expert review method, the usability evaluation index system of the APP interface is determined. Thirdly, a research questionnaire was designed based on the index of the usability evaluation system of the smart toothbrush APP, and the obtained data were subjected to regression analysis, combined with the task-technology fit model, to get the key indicators and the priority of functional requirements affecting the usability of the APP user interface. Finally, the priority of functional requirements obtained above is compared with the expected functional priorities to find the differences between them and optimize the design to improve the satisfaction of the user interface. This research method has theoretical reference and guidance value for usability evaluation of user interfaces of the same type of smart devices and interface design practice.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Internet Digital Technology in the Student Work Smart Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Although the informatization construction of colleges and universities has achieved fruitful results in recent years, it is a common phenomenon that colleges generally still adopt the mode of student management. In order to establish an intelligent management system, this paper explores the establishment of a practical system to assist the student work management system. The student work management system designed in this paper includes essential parts such as fund management, reward and punishment management, and ideological and political management. The system has the characteristics of reliability, scalability, and high security. The results of the regular operation of the system show that the system has brought a qualitative leap to the student management system.

articleTitle: Research on Text Readability Based on Computer Multi-Level Comprehensive Evaluation Model and Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of text readability. This is an important research topic in modern scientific research, and how to quantify the analysis of text difficulty through scientific methods has important practical significance. This paper makes the following research on the readability of text: First, we explore the main factors affecting the text readability. We build a four-layer index system from the perspective of text characteristics and text logic to measure the readability of text. In this indicator system, word length, sentence length, sentence length and sentence average from the perspective of text length, the total number of text syllables, the total number of single syllables, multiple syllables, the number of common words, in terms of the number of text words, which is one of the highlights of this article. The data source of this article is 319 fourth and sixth grade reading materials as well as the text in English journals, with deletion, word segmentation and other preprocessing. We built a classification statistical model of the six metrics to achieve a systematic classification statistics for the six metrics at the first two levels. Statistically in terms of the number of common words and clauses, we used the high-frequency word tables in coca (Corpus of Contemporary American English) and the common logical structure words to build a model to obtain the data. We obtained the number of emotional words to model the number of emotional words, to measure text emotional color. Building on the model, we normalized the resulting raw data so that the metrics were in the same order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Research and System Implementation of Automatic English Synonymy Selection in the Internet Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Taking English synonym terminology as an example, three effective technical means for automatically acquiring Internet terminology resources are proposed, including self-learning of grammatical patterns, extraction of online synonym dictionaries, and crawling of static synonym terminology categories. Based on this, a prototype system of Web Synonym Searcher is designed and implemented. Experimental tests show that automatic acquisition of synonym terms from the Internet is a very promising way.

articleTitle: An Evaluation of Automation on Misogyny Identification(AMI) and Deep-Learning Approaches for Hate Speech -Highlight on Graph Convolutional Networks and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The increasing misogynistic perspectives and the popularized abusive languages toward women appeared on social media worldwide in recent decades. People took advantages from the anonymous accounts spreading hatred and linguistic violence toward women, especially marginalized female groups. To indent this issue from a holistic lens and detect misogynistic aggression during this pandemic recession period, researchers specifically categorized abusive languages into several stratified groups, and utilized deep learning techniques to distinguish the differences between normal languages and unfriendly languages, with the creation of data-sets. To clarify the target, the paper will strictly target Spanish, English, and Hindi languages, and the social media users are concentrated on twitter and Facebook. Most of the research relies on systems of misogyny identification (AMI) and Natural Languages Processing technology (NLP). Besides, this paper will address external explanation and demonstration on Graph attention networks and Semi-supervised classification with graph convolutional networks. To interpret to what extent the misogyny issue can be explained by deep learning and relevant subfields, this paper will further provide a more insightful comprehension for the audience with understanding in depth.

articleTitle: A Graph Optimization Enhanced Indoor Localization Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In GNSS-denied indoor environments, improving the localization accuracy and robustness in a scene map is critical. This paper proposes a graph optimization enhanced indoor localization method. It calculates the location of a pedestrian relative to a scene map by averaging the weighted localization results from the PDR localization, sliding window-based localization, and graph optimization localization. These weighting factors are dynamically adjustable. Sliding window-based localization uses the matched landmarks to estimate the transformation matrix between the window and scene maps, which is performed when a new landmark is added to the sliding window. Due to the time-consuming Wi-Fi landmark matching, this paper uses the semantic landmark matching firstly to improve the matching efficiency. The graph is constructed by using semantic landmarks, Wi-Fi landmarks, and waypoints as nodes. The association relationship between waypoints and landmarks (e.g., waypoint-waypoint, waypoint-semantic, and waypoint-Wi-Fi) and the matching relationship between landmarks (e.g., semantic-semantic and Wi-Fi-Wi-Fi) is employed as constraint edges. This paper performs graph optimization in an optimization window to reduce the computing power consumption. PDR localization has the highest weight when there are no matched landmarks in a window. Experiments are conducted in the office building and mall scenes. Results show that the proposed localization method can achieve less than 0.5 m mean localization error. Moreover, compared to the unoptimized sliding window-based localization, the localization accuracy is improved by at least 17.86 % after optimization window-based graph optimization.

articleTitle: Model and algorithm for Vaccination vehicles routing optimization problem in remote areas
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Considering that there are still many residents in remote areas who are inconvenient for vaccination, in order to improve the distribution and efficiency of COVID-19 vaccination in these areas and effectively prevent possible future deterioration of COVID-19 epidemic, this article aims to optimize the route of the vaccination vehicle, establishing a remote area vaccination vehicle route optimization model and utilizing a mathematical model to solve it. This article takes the data of Xinduqiao Town, Zhaojue, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province as a case to find the optimal dispatch route of vaccination vehicles in remote rural areas, providing suggestions for future vaccination strategies and COVID-19 prevention and control.

articleTitle: A Spatial-Statistics based Framework of Spatial Correlation Analysis of Retail Sales
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Sales data analysis and forecasting is of great importance. In the retail industry, the analysis of retailers' historical sales data can help retailers with purchasing, sales planning and marketing decisions. In real life, there is an interactive relationship between sales of neighboring retailers. Though large number of studies have been conducted to analyze and forecast retail sales, few scholars have considered the impact of spatial correlation of retailers' geographical locations on retailers' sales volume. Therefore, it is of practical and theoretical importance to study the spatial correlation and heterogeneity patterns among neighboring retailers. In this paper, we propose a spatial statistics-based framework for the spatial correlation of retailer sales. First, we investigate the spatial pattern of retailer sales volume using historical sales data of real retailers of a given region and then measure the global spatial correlation pattern using the Moran index. Second, we measured local spatial heterogeneity based on the aggregation map of LISA. The analysis results show that there are significant global correlations among retail sales, and at the same time, there are significant local correlations in some regions.

articleTitle: An adaptive conformal polarization sensitive sub-array direction finding algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: A uniform circular array of conformal polarization-sensitive antennas has occlusion problems in some spatial positions, which will lead to the performance of conventional direction finding algorithm degradation. To solve the problem above, an adaptive sub-array direction finding algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the channel threshold of each antenna array is calculated according to the system sensitivity and channel noise figure. And then the array elements filtered beyond the threshold are adaptively formed into a new sub-array and their amplitude and phase information is extracted for polarization-sensitive array direction finding. Finally, the four-dimensional search is conducted by using the rank loss method to reduce the dimensionality of the search. The simulation results show that the full-array polarization sensitive array direction finding error occurs under the condition of occlusion, but the adaptive conformal polarization sensitive sub-array direction finding algorithm proposed in this paper can still accurately obtain the multi-target airspace-polarization domain parameters.

articleTitle: Spatial Characteristics Analysis of Tourist Spots in Kunming based on POI Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the improvement of people's quality of life, tourism has gradually become one of the daily activities. By obtaining POI data, this paper classifies the tourist spots into four categories (natural landscapes, cultural landscapes, leisure and entertainment, and other landscapes) according to the characteristics of each spot, and then uses the spatial analysis method to analyze the spatial characteristics of the tourist spots in Kunming, which is visualized by ArcGIS software. The results of the study show that (1) the tourist spots in the main areas of Kunming show a spatially clustered distribution, and their number decreases as the distance grows, while those in the suburbs of Kunming show a point-like distribution. (2) The center of the spatial ellipse of various tourist spots is located in the Guandu District of Kunming City, with a south-north distribution trend, in line with the development direction of the urban area of Kunming. (3) Tourist spots in the outskirts of Kunming are few and sparse, and the development of tourism is uneven.

articleTitle: An entity linking method based on graph feature and electricity domain knowledge base
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Entity linking refers to the process of mapping the entity reference in the text to the entity in the knowledge base, which is one of the key steps in the field of knowledge graph and knowledge fusion. We propose a joint graph feature entity linking method based on electrical knowledge base. Firstly, we construct a knowledge base with relatively rich entity information and professional characteristics of electricity domain, then identify the named entity mentions in the text. Based on the semantic similarity of multi features such as joint topic, context and metadata, the referenced linked entities are selected by restart random walk and joint disambiguation in the extended graph model. The experimental results show that the graph based joint feature entity linking method effectively improves the entity linking effect, especially in electricity domain.
